name: Laura Shackelford
bio: Laura studies human evolution and recent human diversity, with a focus on Southeast Asia. She co-directs archaeological field research in northern Laos. Her work also explores how virtual reality and educational games can make human prehistory and archaeological fieldwork accessible to more learners.
